etymologies.etymologyHTML: Genericized trademark from Xerox (“a photocopier”), from xerography, from Ancient Greek ξηρός (xērós, “dry”) and γραφή (graphḗ, “writing”).

definitions.definition: (Philippines, India, dated in Canada, US, colloquial, informal) A photocopy.

quote.citation: 2009, David Ebershoff, The 19th Wife, Random House, →ISBN, page 142:
quote.text: There were twenty pictures in the envelope, xeroxes but clear enough. They documented the scene pretty much as I imagined it.

definitions.definition: (dated, Canada, US, colloquial, informal) A photocopier.
(Philippines, India, dated in Canada, US, colloquial, informal) To make a paper copy or copies by means of a photocopier.
